entries.subject: Five open items from the B1-4 collection engine contract
entries.text:
Parked overnight. Items 1 and 2 change what the code does and hold implementation; the rest can be answered later without rework.

1. Capability spec file format. Neither C4 nor C6 fixes a serialization for a capability spec. The contract proposes a placeholder. Choosing it now avoids a migration of every spec later.

2. Lease, heartbeat and retry-budget numeric defaults. Inherited unresolved from C2 section 10 items 1 and 2. These decide how quickly a lost worker is detected and how long a job can look alive after its process is gone.

3. Where the second transport adapter lives when it arrives: the worker module, or a new transport-adapters module. Not needed until the PAN or SFTP slice.

4. The connect timeout default under ssh_exec. No gate-sourced value exists because connect is gate NOT_APPLICABLE.

5. Whether extending the architecture test suite needs its own amendment document to the B1-1 contract, or can be extended in place. Process question, not a code question.
